opening.argument: The presentation leads with a "$1,000-per-day" crypto arbitrage bot made by ChatGPT, then directs viewers to use the code, fund the contract with Ethereum, and activate it. The speaker explains that the bot is intended to earn passive income through DeFi arbitrage and claims that greater funding can produce greater profit. The demonstration reports about 1.35 ETH as 35% profit and later checks profits after a little over 12 hours, while also acknowledging that profits fluctuate week to week. Those displayed balances and the ETH transfer show only what appears on screen; they do not independently establish that the bot worked, that the returns were genuine or reproducible, or that any withdrawal succeeded.
